entries.summary: Settings › Chat in Talaria Web draws the composer so you show or hide each of its controls by pressing it, chooses the send key, busy-message mode and activity display with segmented controls, names its settings plainly, and moves the workspace panel and rarely changed settings to its own Workspace panel and Advanced pages; on Tools the agent approvals switch sits below the tabs.

announcement.title: Choose composer controls on a picture
announcement.description: Press a control in the drawing of the composer to show or hide it.
